title: Short curves in homogeneous spaces of the unitary group for unitarily invariant norms
summary: Let A be a unital *-subalgebra of $M_n(C)$ and let $M = U(n)/U(A)$, with the quotient Finsler metric induced by a unitarily invariant norm on $u(n)$, normalized so that $||iP|| = 1$ for rank-one projections $P$. This family contains the unitary orbits of Hermitian matrices, in particular flag manifolds and Grassmann manifolds. We prove that if $z_0$ is a minimal lifting of a tangent vector $X$ with $||X||_{\infty} < π/2$, then the one-parameter group $t \mapsto e^{t z_0}\cdot o$ has minimal length among all piecewise smooth curves in $M$ joining its endpoints. The same holds in manifolds…
